title: Build with Stock Tokens
summary: Understand the token model before combining balances, prices, corporate actions, or offchain market data.

links.description: Learn the ERC-20 and ERC-8056 multiplier model, balance presentation, integration patterns, and permissioned primary mint and redemption boundary.
Use Robinhood's live contract registry for WETH, USDG, and Stock Token addresses instead of copying addresses from examples.
Read the public asset, raw underlying price, and corporate-action REST endpoints; prices differ from multiplier-adjusted onchain token feeds and the service is rate-limited.

links.hyperlink: Robinhood Chain oracles and price feeds
links.description: Implement AggregatorV3 reads with decimals, heartbeat staleness, L2 sequencer uptime, multiplier, and oracle-pause checks.
Review the oracle provider's source-of-truth model for total-return values, 24/5 sessions, corporate-action pauses, staleness, and integration risk.
